before.content: 중심이 원점 $O$인 좌표평면 위의 두 점 $A(3,0),B(0,3)$에 대하여 선분 $AB$를 $2:1$로 내분하는 점을 $C$라 하고, $\overrightarrow{OA}=\vec a,\overrightarrow{OC}=\vec c$라고 하자. $\vec p=\vec a+\vec c,\vec q=\dfrac23\vec a-\vec c$라고 할 때, 등식 $|x\vec p+y\vec q|=2\sqrt5$가 성립하도록 하는 실수 $x,y$를 좌표로 하는 점 $P$에 대하여 선분 $OP$의 길이의 최댓값과 최솟값의 합은? [4.6점]

after.content: 중심이 원점 $O$이고 두 점 $F,F'$을 초점으로 하는 타원과 $y$축의 한 교점을 $A$라고 하자. 삼각형 $ABC$의 넓이가 $2\sqrt5$이고 타원의 장축의 길이가 $6$일 때, $(\overline{AO}+\overline{OF})^2$의 값을 구하면? [4.6점]

sourceIssueHolds.reasoning: For u=-p>0 and P=(pt²,2pt), PH=5 and HI=4 give u(1+t²)=5 and u|t|=2, hence u²−5u+4=0. Both u=1 and u=4 satisfy all stated data, so x_F=-1 and x_F=-4; the printed options include -1 but not -4. The scanned official solution circles only choice ② and skips the second branch.
sourceIssueHolds.reason: From PH=5 and HI=4, the algebraic candidates are p=−1 and p=−4. The complete q06 figure includes segment PF sloping down-right, which depicts x_P<x_F; if that diagram order is source-binding, then u=4 (|t|=1/2) is excluded and p=−1 remains. The wording does not state this inequality, so preserve q6 as HOLD for R1/R2 to decide whether the unscaled diagram encodes the needed order.

sourceIssueHolds.reasoning: The locked PDF prints area(AOF/ABC as shown in source) = 2√5 and major axis length 6, while the adjacent explanation marks choice ①. For an ellipse with semimajor axis 3 and foci on the x-axis, b²+c²=9 and area(AOF)=bc/2≤9/4<2√5; thus no such ellipse satisfies the printed numeric condition. Preserve literal text and official-key observation as HOLD for R1/R2; do not repair the factor or replace the item here.
